create.name: Coby Kozlowski
create.bio:
Coby Kozlowski is a yoga and meditation teacher, life coach trainer and writer whose work draws on yoga philosophy, storytelling and the expressive arts. She studied business and environmental studies at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, then took a master's in transformative leadership at Lesley University with a certificate in expressive arts therapy, and later studied coaching, positive psychology and Ayurveda. She has taught for many years on the faculty of the Kripalu School of Yoga, where she developed the Kripalu Vinyasa approach, and she trains teachers of Instinctive Meditation as one of the leaders of the Radiance Sutras School.

Her classes and retreats mix flowing practice, meditation, journaling, conversation and plenty of humour, and often turn on questions of purpose at different stages of life, from her Quarter-Life Calling programme for people in their twenties to a midlife immersion she calls the Holy Wake-Up Call. St. Martin's Press published her first book, One Degree Revolution, about using yoga's teachings to make small, steady changes, and Broadleaf Books brought out The Ache in Your Heart Is Holy in 2026. She gave a TEDx talk in the Berkshires, appears at yoga festivals, and offers private life and spiritual coaching by phone or video.

books.title: One Degree Revolution: How the Wisdom of Yoga Inspires Small Shifts That Lead to Big Changes
books.author: Coby Kozlowski
books.description: Coby's first book takes ideas from classical yoga philosophy and turns them into practical steps for everyday life. Rather than asking for dramatic reinvention, it argues that a slight change of direction, held over time, can alter where a life ends up.

courses.title: The Holy Wake-Up Call: A Midlife Awakening
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, that treats midlife as a doorway rather than a crisis, drawing on the yogic idea of four stages of life. Instinctive Meditation, yoga philosophy, journaling, movement and group conversation help participants ask what they want the next part of life to hold.

courses.title: Meditation in Motion: The Kripalu Approach to Vinyasa
courses.description: A nine-day residential training at Kripalu, co-led by Coby and Ilana Beigel, for yoga teachers who want to lead Kripalu Vinyasa. It covers sequencing across three levels, energetic alignment, the koshas, pranayama and how to weave a philosophical theme through a class, and counts towards Kripalu's 300-hour training.

courses.title: Private Life and Spiritual Coaching
courses.description: Monthly coaching packages with Coby, with two or three short sessions a month, assignments written for each person and email support in between. The work blends life coaching with spiritual inquiry into purpose, relationships and work.
courses.price: $200 USD per month (Standard) or $300 USD per month (Premium)
